review_method: Previously completed direct read, in-memory AST parsing/compilation, exact source diff and standard-library input hashes. This receipt records that review without repeating it or executing the collector.
observed_diff_scope: Add accepted.json, attempt.json, cleanup.json and export-manifest.json to existing top-level receipt/log selection

verified_source_contract.job_selection: Only explicit supplied job list; fixed task job root; gf-20261015- prefix and no slash/dot-dot
verified_source_contract.before_collection: Local query requires terminal state, cleanup_verified=true and workgroup_live=false; remote independently requires terminal status
verified_source_contract.excluded_payloads: Checkpoint directories, symlink files, .ckpt/.pt/.pkl/.tfrecord.gz; does not traverse source data directories
verified_source_contract.training_evidence: Collect recovery/state JSON, checkpoint identities and prediction/metric logs without checkpoint or RNG.pt payloads
verified_source_contract.archive_and_extraction: Refuse existing remote archive; local extraction requires unique names, relative paths without dot-dot, regular-file members only and tar filter=data
verified_source_contract.manifest: Exact archive member set equals manifest files plus COLLECTION_MANIFEST.json; verify each file size and SHA256
verified_source_contract.transport: Remote archive SHA256 and existing verified transfer mechanism retained

operational_boundary: Collect completed jobs in bounded groups, including separate domain training collections as needed under the existing per-collection limit. This review does not authorize collecting running jobs or weakening size/identity checks.
